title: Cozy Mug Sleeve
description: A small rectangle project that wraps around a mug and teaches simple finishing.
expectationText: A practical rectangle that turns into a finished object with one small joining detail at the end.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.instruction: Chain 12 stitches for the height of the sleeve.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Half double crochet in the third chain from the hook and each chain across.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 18
steps.instruction: Chain 2, turn, and half double crochet across until the sleeve wraps around your mug.

steps.title: Add a loop
steps.instruction: Chain a small loop at one short edge for the button closure.

steps.title: Attach the button
steps.instruction: Sew a button to the opposite edge, fasten off, and weave in ends.
